description: This file contains unit tests for the SQS stream adapter in an Orleans-based AWS utility project. It tests sending and receiving messages through an SQS queue, including setup, message handling, and validation of message ordering and content.

classes.name: SQSAdapterTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing SQS stream adapter integration using Orleans framework; includes setup, teardown, message sending, and receiving validation.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous initialization method, currently a no-op.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous cleanup, deletes all used SQS queues if connection string is set.

methods.name: SendAndReceiveFromSQS
methods.description: Test method that initializes the SQS adapter factory and performs send/receive message testing.

methods.name: SendAndReceiveFromQueueAdapter
methods.description: Performs the core testing logic: creates adapter, receivers, sends messages, and asserts message integrity, ordering, and cache correctness.

methods.name: CreateEvents
methods.description: Generates a list of random integer and string events for testing message batches.

methods.name: MakeClusterId
methods.description: Generates a unique cluster identifier based on current UTC timestamp.
